**Newsletter: Seed Swap Indoor and Market on May 4**

Dear community,

We're excited to announce that the seed swap will move indoors on May 4 due to the rain. We've selected one packet of seeds to share with you. Please bring one packet of seeds to participate.

Thank you for your support and participation in our seed swap. We look forward to seeing you indoors on May 4.

Sincerely,  
Founder
